source: Counter Copilot V4 Adversarial QA and Security Acceptance Matrix, sheet 'Test Matrix'
note: No test here has run against an application; none exists. contract_coverage states only what the contract and reference functions prove.

tests.scenario: Quantity value must be supported by the cited words
tests.workbook_expected: Reject the extraction run or mark the quantity ambiguous; do not create a usable extracted value.
tests.pass_condition_change: Run stays schema-valid; the field is downgraded to ambiguous with no value (workbook also allowed rejecting the run). N-5.

tests.scenario: A value must be tied to the correct evidence occurrence
tests.workbook_expected: Reject a value/evidence mismatch even when the correct value appears elsewhere in the same email.

tests.scenario: Measure raw wording and normalized magnitude must agree
tests.workbook_expected: Reject inconsistent normalization; never preserve a numeric magnitude unrelated to raw wording.

tests.scenario: An extracted text value must match a token, not merely a substring
tests.workbook_expected: Reject 'treated' as supported by 'untreated'; enforce token boundaries and negation-aware semantics.

tests.scenario: Do not fabricate a quantity absent from source
tests.workbook_expected: Quantity state must be missing unless the source contains a quantity; no default count.
tests.pass_condition_change: Outcome is ambiguous unsupported_by_source, not missing. N-13.

tests.scenario: Do not infer a length that is not stated
tests.workbook_expected: Keep length missing; do not infer 12 feet or another conventional length.
tests.pass_condition_change: No length or axis field exists; the written dimension sequence is kept and an added component is rejected. U-07.

tests.scenario: Do not infer nominal/actual dimensions or units
tests.workbook_expected: Preserve original dimension_text; axis and unit basis remain unresolved unless an approved deterministic yard convention applies.

tests.scenario: Do not substitute a unit that is not in the source
tests.workbook_expected: Reject incorrect unit mapping; preserve source wording and map only through an approved synonym rule.

tests.scenario: Preserve a fractional measurement exactly
tests.workbook_expected: Only the exact approved normalization (0.4375) may be extracted; mismatches must be rejected or ambiguous.
tests.pass_condition_change: Exactness is proven by the reference check, not by schema validation.

tests.scenario: Handle non-terminating fractions without silent rounding
tests.workbook_expected: Do not silently truncate/round; preserve raw fraction and set ambiguous or unresolved pending an explicit precision policy.

tests.scenario: Distinguish treated from untreated
tests.workbook_expected: Preserve 'untreated' as a distinct value; never accept substring overlap as evidence for 'treated'.

tests.scenario: Respect negation in natural phrasing
tests.workbook_expected: Do not extract the negated attribute as a positive requirement; resolve meaning or mark ambiguous.
tests.not_covered: Negation detection is a fixed word window and not exhaustive.

tests.scenario: Conflicting treatment claims on one line are not silently resolved
tests.workbook_expected: Represent the conflict as ambiguous with evidence for both statements; do not select either value automatically.
tests.not_covered: Relies on the approved correction wording and a fixed treatment term list.

tests.scenario: A clear mid-message correction remains reviewable
tests.workbook_expected: Preserve both statements; under current proposed U-09 default, mark quantity ambiguous until employee resolves.
tests.not_covered: Whether the model cites both statements is a model-quality measure for the benchmark.
tests.pass_condition_change: Cited conflicts are downgraded and omitted corrections warned; model behaviour is scored by benchmark.

tests.scenario: Multiple corrections must not be collapsed silently
tests.workbook_expected: Retain all competing values and correction order; follow approved correction policy, otherwise mark ambiguous.

tests.scenario: Do not mistake quoted reply history for a new correction
tests.workbook_expected: Use threading/quote boundaries and preserve both contexts; do not automatically choose the last number.
tests.not_covered: Quoted history warns only when evidence cites it. Quote detection is heuristic.

tests.scenario: Do not omit a requested line
tests.workbook_expected: Every requested line is represented or explicitly flagged for employee review; no silent omission.
tests.not_covered: Line recall is not guaranteed and has not been measured. The uncited-quantity warning is a partial safeguard that misses omissions without an unread amount; it does not satisfy this test.

acceptance_gate.name: Model line recall
acceptance_gate.pass_condition: Every requested line is represented or explicitly flagged for employee review; no silent omission.
acceptance_gate.evidence_needed: Runs of a real model against labeled synthetic data. The threshold is undecided (U-22).

tests.scenario: Keep attributes attached to the correct line
tests.workbook_expected: No cross-line attribute bleed; evidence for every field must point to that line's source phrase.
tests.not_covered: Depends on the model's line spans being correct.

tests.scenario: Handle repeated or near-identical lines without losing provenance
tests.workbook_expected: Retain separate line identity and source location, or perform an explicitly approved consolidation that preserves both source references.
tests.not_covered: Frontend must show lines separately.

tests.scenario: Silence must remain missing
tests.workbook_expected: Treatment and grade remain missing; never default to untreated or No. 2.

tests.scenario: Contradictory or unclear values must be ambiguous
tests.workbook_expected: Keep value null, list supported candidates, record reason and cite relevant text.

tests.scenario: Approval is blocked when quantity or unit is unresolved
tests.workbook_expected: Compute blockers server-side and reject approval; do not rely on client display or model-supplied blocker list.
tests.not_covered: 422 approval_blocked and no-write behaviour need the service.

tests.scenario: Employee cannot select a SKU outside the current yard catalog
tests.workbook_expected: Reject selection without revealing another yard's SKU existence or details.
tests.not_covered: Yard-scoped catalog lookup needs the service.

tests.scenario: Inactive SKU cannot be selected or approved
tests.workbook_expected: Reject new selection; re-check SKU active state at approval time.
tests.not_covered: Rejecting selection and approval of an inactive SKU needs the service.

tests.scenario: A SKU mismatch requires visible warning and acknowledgement
tests.workbook_expected: Display exact mismatched attributes; do not suppress disagreement; acknowledgement is tied to the warning version.
tests.not_covered: Tying acknowledgment to approval and the screen need application code.

tests.scenario: Single catalog candidate is not automatically selected
tests.workbook_expected: Candidate remains a suggestion; selection is null until an authorized employee chooses it.
tests.not_covered: UI and service behaviour untested.

tests.scenario: Parsed body must match preserved original
tests.workbook_expected: Server derives canonical body or detects mismatch; quarantine/reject before extraction.
tests.not_covered: 422, quarantine and no-job behaviour need the intake service.

tests.scenario: Sender, recipients and subject cannot be forged by metadata
tests.workbook_expected: Server compares authoritative headers or records a rigorously defined trusted adapter attestation; never silently trusts conflicting fields.
tests.not_covered: Credential-to-yard mapping, mailbox check, quarantine and audit need the intake service.

tests.scenario: Attachment hashes and metadata must agree with raw MIME parts
tests.workbook_expected: Recompute digest and size server-side; mark mismatch and do not pass unverified attachment metadata downstream.
tests.not_covered: Intake service must use only the derived facts.

tests.scenario: Identical redelivery is idempotent
tests.workbook_expected: Return duplicate response on second delivery; retain one communication and one processing job.
tests.not_covered: Needs intake service and database uniqueness. Content fingerprint is covered separately.

tests.scenario: Same external identity with different content is quarantined
tests.workbook_expected: Keep first original immutable; quarantine second bytes; set conflict flag; do not merge or replace original.
tests.not_covered: 409, quarantine and audit need the service.
tests.pass_condition_change: Error code is conflicting_redelivery (workbook says conflicting_delivery).

tests.scenario: Concurrent duplicate deliveries cannot race into duplicate records
tests.workbook_expected: Exactly one communication and one logical processing job; all callers receive consistent duplicate/new results.
tests.not_covered: Needs concurrent intake against a database.

tests.scenario: Tenant-A employee cannot GET Tenant-B request
tests.workbook_expected: Deny access without disclosing whether the resource exists.
tests.not_covered: Membership checks and 404 behaviour need the service.

tests.scenario: Tenant-A employee cannot mutate Tenant-B request or select its SKU
tests.workbook_expected: Reject before mutation; do not reveal foreign record fields.
tests.not_covered: Mutation checks and audit need the service.

tests.scenario: Private originals cannot be fetched by guessing or reusing object keys
tests.workbook_expected: All access must flow through yard-scoped authorization; storage objects are not public.
tests.not_covered: Private storage and per-request authorization need deployment.

tests.scenario: Editor without approve permission cannot approve
tests.workbook_expected: Deny action server-side regardless of UI control visibility.
tests.not_covered: Enforcement, unchanged version and denial audit need the service. Roles depend on U-05.

tests.scenario: Decline/reopen permissions are checked independently
tests.workbook_expected: Permission must be action-specific; one permission cannot authorize another decision.
tests.not_covered: Enforcement needs the service. Roles depend on U-05.

tests.scenario: Original download permission is separate from parsed communication read
tests.workbook_expected: Deny original download while leaving permitted parsed text access intact.
tests.not_covered: Enforcement and audit need the service.

tests.scenario: CSRF, session expiry and revocation protect mutations
tests.workbook_expected: Reject all unsafe requests; GET remains non-mutating.
tests.not_covered: Sessions and CSRF enforcement depend on U-01 and the service.

tests.scenario: Optimistic locking permits only one stale-version edit
tests.workbook_expected: One commit succeeds; second receives version_conflict and must reload/resolve; never silently merge.
tests.not_covered: Only the required expected_version is checked. Conflict handling needs a database.

tests.scenario: Multi-operation edit is atomic
tests.workbook_expected: Apply all operations or none; no partial field update.
tests.not_covered: Transactional atomicity needs the service.

tests.scenario: Edit racing with approval has a single serializable outcome
tests.workbook_expected: Exactly one operation wins according to transaction ordering; approval must hash the exact reviewed version.
tests.not_covered: Locking and approval hash need the service.

tests.scenario: Same employee idempotency key and same body replays stored response
tests.workbook_expected: Return original stored response; do not create a second revision or approval.
tests.not_covered: Stored replay needs the service.

tests.scenario: Same key with different body is rejected
tests.workbook_expected: Reject request and never reinterpret the prior key.
tests.not_covered: 409 idempotency_conflict needs the service.

tests.scenario: Lost success response followed by retry cannot duplicate intake or mutation
tests.workbook_expected: Retry returns durable prior outcome and does not duplicate work.
tests.not_covered: Needs the service and a database.

tests.scenario: HTML/script content is treated as untrusted data
tests.workbook_expected: Preserve original bytes but never execute or render active HTML; extraction receives sanitized/plain-text representation under explicit policy.
tests.not_covered: Frontend must render text only.

tests.scenario: Oversized body/original is rejected before resource exhaustion
tests.workbook_expected: Enforce limits at edge and application; reject before partial record/job persistence.
tests.not_covered: 413 at the edge and store-nothing behaviour need the service.

tests.scenario: Suspicious or malformed attachments remain inert and unprocessed in pilot
tests.workbook_expected: Do not parse/execute attachments in v0.1; preserve safely within resource limits, mark unprocessed, quarantine where policy requires.
tests.not_covered: Hard parse timeout and process isolation need the service.

tests.scenario: Email instructions cannot override system policy
tests.workbook_expected: Treat all email text as untrusted data; extract only material facts; no secret access, SKU selection or approval.
tests.not_covered: Model adapter must have no tools, secrets or actions.

tests.scenario: Prompt injection in subject, quoted history or HTML has the same untrusted status
tests.workbook_expected: No untrusted subfield gains instruction authority; preserve source evidence and only extract request content.
tests.not_covered: HTML comments are stripped by derivation; filename handling needs the service.

tests.scenario: Model cannot create unsupported business-action fields
tests.workbook_expected: Strict schema rejects unknown or prohibited fields; no downstream action is inferred from free text.
tests.not_covered: Application must not create a draft from a rejected run.

tests.scenario: Later email never silently overwrites an existing employee-edited request
tests.workbook_expected: Create a new linked/flagged communication or draft according to approved follow-up policy; preserve old request and employee edit.
tests.not_covered: Linking and separate drafts need the service. Contract fields exist.

tests.scenario: Reprocessing a communication cannot replace employee-entered values
tests.workbook_expected: Do not re-extract or replace an existing request; require an explicit future reprocess design with conflict protection.
tests.not_covered: Worker idempotency needs the service.

tests.scenario: An approved request remains historically immutable after a new email
tests.workbook_expected: Keep prior approved version and approval record; create a separate linked request or follow-up event; never mutate approved content.
tests.not_covered: Immutability of approved versions needs the service.

tests.scenario: Evidence offsets use Unicode code points, not UTF-16 code units
tests.workbook_expected: Server computes and verifies offsets in Unicode code points; frontend converts offsets correctly before highlighting.
tests.not_covered: Frontend conversion from code points to UTF-16 is untested.

tests.scenario: Repeated identical quotes use the correct occurrence
tests.workbook_expected: Resolve occurrence deterministically and store the exact source start/end for the intended line.

tests.scenario: Raw email bytes remain unchanged while normalized text is separately traceable
tests.workbook_expected: Preserve original byte-for-byte; record explicit decoding/canonicalization rules for derived body_text; evidence offsets index that exact canonical text.
tests.not_covered: Byte-for-byte storage of the original needs the service.
